intervals.label: Ring Cyclotron went into operation
intervals.locator: PSI Center for Accelerator Science and Engineering, page "The Ring Cyclotron", first paragraph; corroborated by the HIPA-turns-50 story ("went into operation in 1974")
intervals.note: The machine has been upgraded substantially since 1974 (for example to a beam power of 1.4 MW, see the beam-power spec), but no source consulted gives a separate upgrade-interval date.
intervals.quote: The Ring cyclotron is a separated sector cyclotron with a fixed beam energy of 590 MeV, built by PSI and commissioned in 1974.

name: High Intensity Proton Accelerator
notes: Beam power: the official psi.ch/en/cas/hipa page (checked 2026-09-17) gives 1.4 MW. The 1974 start year is stated by PSI's Ring Cyclotron page and by an official PSI news story (src:facilities-verify-psi-hipa-turns-50: 'went into operation in 1974').

beam_energy.note: PSI's own official HIPA page states the proton energy.
beam_energy.quote: accelerates the proton bunches up to 590 MeV (79 % of the speed of light)

beam_power.note: PSI's own official HIPA page states the facility's beam power as 1.4 MW.
beam_power.quote: The High Intensity Proton Accelerator Facility (HIPA) provides a 1.4 MW proton beam for the production of mesons and neutrons.
